issues.explanation: «خطرها» appears in alternatives_fa while «خطر» (its singular root) is in rejected_fa on the stated ground that «خطر» conflates risk with hazard/danger. The plural carries the same conceptual conflation; listing the plural as a searchable alias while rejecting the singular is logically inconsistent and undermines the rejection.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «خطرها» from alternatives_fa or move it to rejected_fa alongside «خطر», adding a note that both forms were encountered in translated texts but are rejected for conflating مخاطره with خطر (hazard/danger).

issues.explanation: The proposed preferred_fa is «حریم خصوصی» but no supplied evidence clause formally prints this as the INSO term for privacy. The single printed-evidence entry (INSO 23728 clause 4.1) is an informative note, not a term-definition clause, and its text consistently uses «حریم اطلاعاتی» — not «حریم خصوصی» — for the privacy concept. Rule 1 requires the preferred term to equal what the cited standard prints; the evidence as supplied supports «حریم اطلاعاتی».
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) add a formal term-definition clause (term_fa_printed / term_en_printed structure) from an INSO standard that formally prints «حریم خصوصی» for privacy, or (b) change preferred_fa to «حریم اطلاعاتی» to match the supplied evidence and move «حریم خصوصی» to alternatives_fa as the common/colloquial form.

issues.explanation: In rejected_fa the form «اندازهگیری» is missing the ZWNJ required between «اندازه» and «گیری». The correct orthography — used in the editor_note of this same entry — is «اندازه‌گیری».

In alternatives_fa the form «ریسک باقیمانده» is missing the ZWNJ between «باقی» and «مانده». The printed evidence reads «مخاطره‌های باقی‌مانده» (with ZWNJ) and the preferred_fa «مخاطرهٔ باقی‌مانده» also uses it correctly.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «ریسک باقیمانده» with «ریسک باقی‌مانده» in alternatives_fa.

issues.explanation: «رهگیری» (tracking / tracing a moving entity) is semantically distinct from «پایش» (monitoring = determining the status of a system or process over time, per the printed INSO 42001 clause 3.20 definition). No supplied INSO evidence shows «رهگیری» used as a synonym for monitoring. Its inclusion as an alias risks conflating monitoring with tracking, and the editor_note does not explain or justify its addition.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «رهگیری» from alternatives_fa unless a printed INSO source is supplied showing it used interchangeably with «پایش» / monitoring.
